Good to know

Your questions, answered.

I haven’t chosen a venue yet. Can I enquire?+

Yes. Share your city, approximate guest count and the type of celebration you have in mind. You can tell us that the venue is still being decided.

What should I send with my enquiry?+

Your event type, preferred date and city are useful first details. A guest estimate, budget range and a few design references help us understand your priorities.

Will the form send a message automatically?+

No. It opens WhatsApp with a prepared message that you can edit and send yourself.

Can I call instead?+

Of course. You can call +91 70755 05617 to discuss your occasion directly.
